datasets.name: Natural Earth 1:50m Land Polygons
datasets.provider: Natural Earth Vector (Public Domain, supported by NACIS & USGS)
datasets.geographic_coverage: Southern Hemisphere (south of -30 deg latitude), encompassing circum-Antarctic landmass, Antarctic Peninsula, South Shetland Islands, South Orkney, South Georgia, Tierra del Fuego, Southern Africa, and Tasmania.
datasets.intended_use: Broad regional exclusion screening only. Identifies continental landmasses and major islands.
datasets.limitations: Highly generalized at 1:50m scale (approx. 5-10 km coastal resolution). Omits rocks, islets, and reefs under 5 km in size. Smooths complex fjords and narrow sounds. DOES NOT PROVE NAVIGABLE WATER OR VESSEL CLEARANCE AT TACTICAL SCALE. Coastal navigation within 25 km requires high-resolution charting (e.g. SCAR ADD v7.7 / UKHO).

datasets.name: Natural Earth 1:50m Antarctic Ice Shelves
datasets.provider: Natural Earth Vector (derived from SCAR Antarctic Digital Database & USGS)
datasets.geographic_coverage: Circum-Antarctic ice shelf polygons (Ross, Ronne-Filchner, Amery, Larsen C, Fimbul, Riiser-Larsen, Shackleton, West, etc.).
datasets.intended_use: Coarse barrier screening against major permanent ice shelves.
datasets.limitations: Static polygons representing multi-year average boundaries. Calving fronts advance and retreat dynamically by several kilometers annually. Does not represent seasonal fast ice, tide cracks, or dynamic iceberg calving margins.

datasets.name: BYU/NIC Antarctic Iceberg Database
datasets.provider: Brigham Young University (BYU) Center for Remote Sensing / National Ice Center (NIC)
datasets.intended_use: Dynamic collision hazard screening against major tracked tabular icebergs (>= 10 NM / 18.5 km length).
datasets.limitations: Does not track bergy bits, growlers (< 5 km), or radar-stealthy ice fragments. Positions older than 48 hours without satellite refresh are considered stale.

datasets.name: Bathymetry & Water Depth
datasets.limitations: Water depth and under-keel clearance (UKC) are NOT modeled by this system. Charted shallows, grounding lines, and submerged pinnacles must be independently verified using official Hydrographic Office navigational charts.
